senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of כּוֹחָל)to paint the eyelids (for medical or for cosmetic purposes).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:3">Sabb. VIII, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 78b:2">78ᵇ</cite>) <he>כדי לִכְחוֹל וכ׳</he> a quantity sufficient for painting one eye.
<cite ref="Shabbat 80a:7">Sabb. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>צנועות כּוֹחֲלוֹת וכ׳</he> chaste (veiled) women paint only one eye.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:6">Ib. X, 6</cite> <he>הכּוֹחֶלֶת</he> she who paints her eyes (on the Sabbath); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>כָּחוּל</he>; f. <he>כְּחוּלָה</he>, pl. <cite ref="K00990"><he>כְּחוּלוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:2">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (play on <he>ח̇כ̇ל̇ילי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:12">Gen. XLIX, 12</cite>) <he>שעיניהם כ̇ח̇ול̇ות וכ̇ח̇ם יפה וכ׳</he> whose eyes are bright as if painted, and whose abilities for study are fine. [Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top <he>להכחיל</he>, <he>מכחיל</he>, v. <cite ref="B00480"><he>בָּחַל</he> II</cite>.]
